fields.label: Submission Name
fields.description: Unique name / reference number for the submission.

fields.label: Broker
fields.description: Name or ID of the broker submitting on behalf of the insured.

fields.label: Carrier
fields.description: Target insurance carrier for this submission.

fields.label: Submission Status
fields.description: Current status of the submission in the workflow.

fields.label: Line of Business
fields.description: Insurance line being placed.

fields.label: Insured Name
fields.description: Legal name of the insured entity.

fields.label: Insured State
fields.description: State of domicile for the insured.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Policy effective date requested by the insured.

fields.label: Expiration Date
fields.description: Policy expiration / renewal date.

fields.label: Date Submitted
fields.description: Timestamp when the submission was sent to the carrier.

fields.label: Requested Premium
fields.description: Target or estimated premium amount requested.

fields.label: Quoted Premium
fields.description: Premium as quoted by the carrier.

fields.label: Bound Premium
fields.description: Final bound premium.

fields.label: Total Insured Value
fields.description: Total value of assets being insured.

fields.label: Commission Rate
fields.description: Broker commission percentage on this submission.

fields.label: Number of Employees
fields.description: Headcount of the insured entity.

fields.label: Annual Revenue
fields.description: Reported annual revenue of the insured.

fields.label: Is Renewal
fields.description: Indicates whether this is a renewal of an existing policy.

fields.label: Is Bound
fields.description: True once the submission has been bound into a policy.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Internal priority flag for queue management.

fields.label: Coverage Types
fields.description: All coverage types included in this submission.

fields.label: Broker Email
fields.description: Primary email address of the broker contact.

fields.label: Broker Phone
fields.description: Direct phone number for the broker.

fields.label: Carrier Portal URL
fields.description: Link to the carrier submission portal for this record.

fields.label: Underwriting Notes
fields.description: Free-form notes from the underwriter during review.

fields.label: Stages
fields.description: Master list of underwriting stages.
